## 2. The MRT-LB model for the diagonal-anisotropic diffusion equation

In this section; we will present a unified MRT-LB model for the diagonal-anisotropic diffusion equation (1) where the transformation matrix constructed in a natural way and the DdQ(2d + 1) lattice structure are employed . In particular; for the isotropic diffusion equation; another MRT-LB model with the DdQ(2d + 1) lattice structure [fewer discrete velocities than the DdQ(2d? + 1) lattice structure] is also provided.
